notes: Two supplied possessives decided differently in one verse: ho adelphos has no genitive pronoun and takes our on the article under rule 20's second arm, while toi agapetoi kai synergoi hemon has a free genitive pronoun and its article is emptied under rule 20 proper. Verified on review.

sunergoi -> fellow worker heads on worker under rule 66, worker glossing the -ergos element rather than completing it; the same analysis is used for systratiotei at PHM.1.2 and synaichmalotos at PHM.1.23.
Philemoni keeps its own supplied to under rule 21's determinerless clause, the following article being emptied and so having no determiner to anchor.
